name: @pcnaid/securepatch-bench
description: A defensive benchmark for complete remediation of authorization, tenant-isolation, and webhook-security defects in TypeScript SaaS systems.
author: Abdul Badran <badran.abdul@pcnaid.com> (https://pcnaid.com)

scripts.list: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js list
scripts.validate: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js validate
scripts.pilot: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js pilot --write docs/pilot-results.json
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js pilot
scripts.report: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js report --input docs/pilot-results.json --output docs/PILOT_RESULTS.md
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate && npm run check:snapshot && npm run check:report
